correctness.rationale: Every full outbreak on a rooted tree requires and suffices that each vertex reach all of its children. Conditional iid edge contacts and iid lifetime independence give the product of moments; changing roots changes only one moment factor. Positive-moment Cauchy–Schwarz gives strict degree ordering for nondeterministic lifetime. Exact beta integral yields the exponential case. CHECKER.py independently tested all 120 source/rate/distribution cases via exact rational Markov recurrence and outgoing-edge enumeration.

value.rationale: The event-specific degree-only law is a complete structural classification of catastrophic eventual all-vertex infection risk across every finite tree. Degree-preserving rewiring invariance and the exact degree-two/leaf risk ratio equal to 1 plus squared coefficient of variation of individual transmissibility isolate a biologically interpretable source-heterogeneity mechanism, not just a small graph enumeration. General finite trees and arbitrary positive iid infectious periods are treated; empirical inference/other severity objectives are explicitly excluded.
